new_results.statement: For every 0<epsilon<=1/4, five independent Uniform[-1/2,1/2] inputs give T_epsilon=(Y1+W1)^2-(sqrt(epsilon)(Y2+W2)+epsilon^(-1/2)Z)^2. Deleting -2epsilon Y2W2 is an exact account03/B03 r43 triangle packet with density cap 3, but restoring that arbitrarily small crossing gives ess sup p_T=infinity via a logarithmic U^2-V^2 singularity. Thus r43 cannot be perturbatively extended using only its triangle currency. This is not a QFORM counterexample because the core rank is two.

For anchored [[b,r^T],[c,N]] with rank N=2 and N=s1u1v1^T+s2u2v2^T, J_sep=tau^2+||r_perp||^2(s1^2c2^2+s2^2c1^2)+||c_perp||^2(s1^2r2^2+s2^2r1^2)+(s1^2+s2^2)||c_perp||^2||r_perp||^2, tau=s1s2[b-r^TN^+c]. The instability family has tau=0 and zero perpendicular terms, so it exactly collapses J_sep.

Adding an independent S^2 gives Q_epsilon with nonzero spectrum {2,1,-(epsilon^-1+2epsilon)}. The physical triple (Y1,Z,S) is diag(1,-epsilon^-1,1), so pinned e5f Theorem A gives ||p_Q||infinity<=6sqrt(pi) and linear small-ball. Every disjoint physical cross cut has rank<=2, so pinned D/D'/D5 all have zero third/fifth crossing volume on the same family.
